text:
Could occur on its own or in association with generalized atopy (asthma,
eczema, seasonal (change spring) catarrh)
Clinical Features
- Itching of the eyes with grittiness
- May be associated with itchy ears and throat, or sinusitis
- Brownish discolouration of the conjunctiva
- Eyelid oedema
- Red eyes occasionally, with watering when acute
- Follicles on the bulbar conjunctiva especially at the limbus
- Papillae on the tarsal conjunctiva (seen on eversion of the eyelid)
- Phlycten in tuberculosis- appears as a yellow nodule with surrounding
leash of engorged vessels
